name: Image Grid Displacement
description: Portrait image drawn on a canvas as a fine grid of cells that get pushed around by the cursor and ease back into place, creating a liquid displacement effect.
contents: One canvas image framed by a border
behavior: Cursor movement over the canvas displaces nearby grid cells of the image
Cells ease back to their original position when the cursor stops or leaves
Touch dragging triggers the same displacement
Canvas shrinks to fit narrow screens
editableByProps: Image source, canvas size, grid density

needsCodeEdit.where: update method of the Cell class

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Image must allow cross-origin canvas drawing is not required since pixels are never read
